{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the 'revenue' column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Group by 'channel' and sum revenue
total_revenue_by_channel = df.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Sort by revenue descending
total_revenue_by_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.sort_values(by='revenue_clean', ascending=False)

# Print the results
total_revenue_by_channel"}
